name: insights-120x40
status: Calibrated on the built Insights screen at 120x40 with a synthetic dated fixture. Every step matched at pinned and real clocks, and dates-check matched all 28 period rows. Recheck changed screens with snap and dates-check before marking a revised profile calibrated.

markers_from.footer: the last row: 'reading since HH:MM:SS' while a read runs (entry, r, a first read of a report or period, a stale report), 'read at HH:MM:SS' once it has finished; the footer keeps its status under help
markers_from.reports: body headings that sit in the first rows of an unscrolled page: Recap 'WHERE THE HOURS WENT', Tools 'LONGEST CALL'. A scrolled Tools page lower down also has a 'LONGEST CALLS' section, so the heading alone is never read as 'at the top'
markers_from.period row: right-aligned on the second row: 'Nov 16 – 22' while a first read is only requested, 'Nov 16 – 22, 2026 · so far · N days recorded' once read, and a refresh keeps the old body and the long form. Months read 'November 2026'. <<dates:tw|lw|tm|lm>> and <<short:...>> are expanded by the harness at the display clock (checked against the product by `dates-check`)
markers_from.loading body: 'Reading Tools for last week from T3, started HH:MM:SS.' names the report and the period; shown for a first read, and for a read of a report whose result went stale (another report was refreshed since); an r refresh keeps its old body
markers_from.help: INSIGHTS HELP, closed by the same key; Esc closes help first and would add the parser's wait to a timed key
markers_from.scroll: '▲ N above' on the row above the body once it is scrolled; N counts rows

pending: read evidence is rchar: the candidate's reader reads through read(2) (about 19 MB for a this-week read on the default fixture), so the counter rises; an mmap reader would need per-thread CPU instead (TERMINAL_UX.md)
not observed: other terminal widths (this profile is 120x40 only), a terminal that answers the start-up queries differently, any real database
scroll position after a period change is assumed to reset (the scroll steps start from the top of Tools this month); the run fails closed if it does not

all: Reading Recap for <<word:tw>> from T3, started \d\d:\d\d:\d\d

confirmed: i opens Insights on Recap for this week and returns to Live; Esc also returns, after closing help
each open reads again (the snapshot is discarded on close); r reads the shown report again and keeps its old body until it finishes
a first visit to a report or period reads; a revisit in the same visit is answered from the snapshot, unless another report was refreshed since, which makes the other report read again
the screen redraws only on a key that changes it, a resize, a finished read and Live's header clock (visible only under a real clock)
